name: Skinkandy Limited
summary: Skinkandy Limited sells body jewelry and provides body piercing services and retails fashion jewellery and aftercare products in Australia and New Zealand. The company offers products, such as flatbacks, earrings, segment rings, hoops, and navel jewelry made from materials including 14K solid gold, implant-grade titanium, and surgical steel. It offers services, including professional body piercing for ears, nose, face, mouth, navel, and body. The company serves customers through its retail stores, as well as its online store. Skinkandy Limited was founded in 2010 and is based in Maroochydore, Australia.
